why: Searches turned up only the arithmetic special case (already resolved pre-2024 by Lindenstrauss/Soundararajan, with a 2025 extension to products of hyperbolic 2- and 3-spaces by Shem-Tov and Silberman) and unrelated settings (magnetic Laplacians on T^2, semiclassical measures on hyperbolic manifolds, Cayley graphs). Multiple sources confirm the general QUE conjecture for arbitrary negatively-curved manifolds, as stated in the bullet, remains completely open.

found.title: Arithmetic quantum unique ergodicity for products of hyperbolic 2- and 3-spaces
found.note: Proves AQUE (arithmetic special case) for Hecke-Maass forms on products of hyperbolic 2- and 3-spaces; not the general negatively-curved-manifold conjecture stated in the bullet.

found.title: Semiclassical Measures on Hyperbolic Manifolds
found.note: Studies possible supports of semiclassical measures on hyperbolic manifolds; adjacent topic, not a resolution of QUE.

found.title: Quantum unique ergodicity for magnetic Laplacians on T^2
found.note: Different setting (magnetic Laplacian on flat torus), not negatively-curved-manifold QUE.
